verdict.rationale: Dynadot is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar. Its core product is the accredited relationship with domain registries, which cannot be self-hosted, so asking to self-host it is a category error for this product type. The WHMCS reseller integration and the API/MCP are hosted-service access points, not a self-hostable deployment of the core product, and nothing in the evidence shows a self-hosting option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
